meta.name: local-seo
meta.description: Local SEO and Google Business Profile audit: diagnose why a business isn't ranking in the local pack / map results and produce a fix plan. Covers GBP completeness, NAP (name/address/phone) consistency across the site and citations, local pack and "near me" ranking factors, review velocity and responses, local landing pages, service-area pages, and LocalBusiness JSON-LD. Use whenever the user asks about local rankings, map results, Google Maps ranking, NAP consistency, store/branch pages, or multi-location SEO. Trigger on: "local SEO", "Google Business Profile", "GBP audit", "rank on Google Maps", "local pack", "map pack", "near me ranking", "NAP", "local citations", "my business isn't on the map", "why don't I show up on Google Maps", "store locator SEO", "multi-location SEO", "service area pages", or any location-based ranking question. For full-site (non-local) audits use /seo-analysis; for a single URL use /seo-page.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 找出本地门店排不上谷歌地图的病因,拿到可执行的修复清单
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果本地生意在谷歌地图或「附近」搜索里排不上号,想弄清原因并动手改。
copy.tagline_en: Find out why your local business is missing from map results and get a fix plan.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your local business isn't showing up on Google Maps or 'near me' searches.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会审查你店铺的本地 SEO:比对站点与各出处上的名称/地址/电话是否一致,检查 Google Business Profile 资料完整度、评论、本地落地页和 LocalBusiness 结构化数据,最后交出一份带评分和优先修复清单的报告。
howto.when: 当你问本地排名、Google Maps 地图排名或 NAP 一致性时触发;整站(非本地)审计改用 /seo-analysis,单个网址用 /seo-page。

say.text: 检查我的 Google Business Profile 还缺哪些字段
say.note: 会逐项打分并列出空白字段

say.text: 我的店名、地址、电话在各平台一致吗?列个表
say.note: 会输出 NAP 对照表并标出不一致项

howto.what_en: Claude audits your local SEO: NAP consistency across the site and citations, Google Business Profile completeness, reviews, local landing pages, and LocalBusiness schema; it returns a scored report with a prioritized fix list.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about local rankings, Google Maps ranking, or NAP consistency; for full-site audits use /seo-analysis, for a single URL use /seo-page.

say_en.text: Audit https://example.com for local SEO - why don't I show up on Maps?
say_en.note: Checks NAP, GBP, reviews, landing pages, schema, then reports

say_en.text: Check which fields are missing from my Google Business Profile
say_en.note: Scores each profile and lists the empty fields

say_en.text: Is my name, address and phone consistent? Give me a table
say_en.note: Outputs a NAP table flagging mismatches
